xy_scoring.axis_definition_reason: These parameters reflect India's drone imaging market, emphasizing payload performance, regulatory compliance, and government-driven manufacturing and contracts. They balance product technology with commercial scale specific to Indian policies and defense needs.

x.Sensor & Imaging Payload Performance: Resolution, low-light sensitivity, thermal/IR capability, and stabilization of onboard cameras and sensors. Evidence: payload specs (e.g., 4K/8K, thermal), gimbal accuracy, and third-party performance benchmarks.
x.Drone Platform Endurance & Range: Flight time, operational range, and payload capacity of the drone platform itself. Evidence: published endurance (minutes), range (km), and max takeoff weight from datasheets or field tests.
x.AI/ML Onboard Processing Capability: Ability to run real-time object detection, tracking, and autonomous navigation on the drone. Evidence: onboard compute (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson), supported algorithms, and latency figures.
x.Payload Integration & Modularity: Ease of swapping cameras, LiDAR, or multispectral sensors and integrating with third-party systems. Evidence: standardized interfaces, plug-and-play payload options, and SDK availability.
x.Regulatory Compliance & Certification: Compliance with Indian DGCA rules, type certification, and security clearances for defense use. Evidence: DGCA certifications, NPNT compliance, and military-grade testing.

y.Domestic Manufacturing Scale (PLI/Drone: Production capacity and participation in Indian government schemes like PLI for drones and Drone Didi. Evidence: annual production units, PLI approval, and local assembly lines.
y.Government & Defense Contract Wins: Awarded tenders from Indian armed forces, paramilitary, and state governments. Evidence: contract values, customer names (e.g., Indian Army), and order books.
y.Revenue Growth & Funding: Annual revenue, growth rate, and investment raised from VCs or strategic partners. Evidence: reported financials, funding rounds, and valuation.
y.Customer Base & Partnerships: Diversity of clients (agriculture, mining, security) and tie-ups with tech providers or distributors. Evidence: named customers, MoUs, and channel partners.
y.Export & Global Market Access: Sales outside India and compliance with foreign regulations. Evidence: export orders, international certifications, and overseas distributors.

relevance.market_definition: The drone imaging market encompasses hardware, software, and services for capturing, processing, and analyzing aerial imagery using unmanned aerial vehicles.
